answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit and prove sustained useful work before it can transact. A new identity starts at its nadir, with tiny limits, and only climbs, like crossing a knoll, after verified tasks, peer attestations, and a waiting period. Creating thousands of fake accounts then means funding each deposit, waiting through the same delay, and risking slashing if any account misbehaves. A canyon between cheap registration and real influence makes mass forgery expensive while honest newcomers can still enter gradually.
